Selected Projects

Click to view full campaign proposal.

IMC Campaign
Insta360 X5 — "Frame? Whatever."
Final Year Project · Integrated Marketing Campaign · 2026
Centered on the core feature “Shoot First, Frame Later” of the Insta360 X5, we address young users’ shooting-related stress. We translate the technical selling point of “panoramic photography” into the brand proposition “Break Free from Framing Constraints”. Through content marketing, UGC campaigns, offline experiences and out-of-home communications, we build a brand-new perception of the X5 within everyday photography scenarios.
Brand Strategy
MINISO Canada — "Spark the MINI Moment"
Canadian market · Repositioning · 2025
This project addresses MINISO’s vague positioning in Canada, rebranding it as a low-burden emotional-value daily-life brand. Facing polarized local retail competition, the campaign uses TVC, city events, KOLs and UGC challenges to build distinct brand identity.
